sloka: न शर्म लब्ध्वा तमेव शरणं गतः ।। ५.३८.३५।।।।
transliteration: na śarma labdhvā tameva śaraṇaṁ gataḥ ।। 5.38.35।।।।

translations.english: 'Rama, you saw the crow in pain and despondency who returned to you and said that it is not possible to make Brahma's weapon ineffectual.You may tell now. (what should be done.)
